test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**In the following passage, a word has been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Gifting is generally taken to be the easiest act to ________, if only you have the heart to part with something in your ________.
solution:
The correct words are: **perform and possession **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Perform** means carry out, accomplish, or fulfil an action, task, or function.

 
 
• **Example -** *I have my duties to **perform**.*
 
 
 
• **Possession** means the state of having, owning, or controlling something.
 
 
• **Example - ***She came into **possession** of a rare silver coin.*
 
 
 
• According to the given sentence, **P****erform** and **Possession** is the most appropriate words.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *Gifting is generally taken to be the easiest act to **perform__**, if only you have the heart to part with something in your **__possession__**. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Forsake** means to stop doing or having something.
 
• **Capacity** means the amount that something can produce.
 
• **Forgive** means to stop feeling angry or resentful towards someone for an offence, flaw, or mistake.
 
• **Discretion** means the right or ability to decide something.
 
• **Observe** means to watch carefully the way something happens or the way someone does something.
 
• **Control** means to exercise authoritative or dominating influence over someone or something.
